build_eomt_model: build an EoMT model for universal segmentation using EomtConfig and EomtForUniversalSegmentation
create_eomt_config: create an EomtConfig with custom segmentation parameters like num_queries, num_blocks, and loss weights
run_eomt_forward: run the EoMT forward pass on pixel values to produce mask and class query logits
initialize_eomt_weights: initialize EoMT model weights using the EomtPreTrainedModel _init_weights method
compute_eomt_loss: compute EoMT segmentation loss from mask labels, class labels, and predicted logits
